steps.title: Inspect Your Property
steps.description: Use the room-by-room checklist to systematically document every defect — from hollow tiles and water seepage to electrical faults and door alignment issues.

steps.title: Submit Defects to Your Developer
steps.description: Use the ready-to-use submission templates included in the PDF to formally notify your developer within your Defect Liability Period (DLP).

steps.title: Plan Your Renovation & Fit-Out
steps.description: Once defects are resolved, let IdealHub handle your renovation. Our turnkey service covers carpentry, electrical, plumbing, painting, and full interior fit-outs — all managed through our platform.
